verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says Ollama can 'hotswap' models without restarting the server, and ollama pull makes new models available immediately. First-party material supports this: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models and advertises running multiple models concurrently, though the docs are marketing-level and the concurrency claim sits on the pricing page. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of model load/unload and switching behavior on a running local server, and confirmation that the concurrent-models claim applies to the local server rather than only cloud plans.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: the ability to 'hotswap' models with different utility instead of restarting the server
Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
